source_text: De arca Noe. Longitudo trecentorum cubitorum, latitudo quinquaginta, altitudo triginta; in summitate in cubitum coartatur. Tria tabulata. De mundis septena, de immundis bina. Escas congrega. Fecit Noe omnia quae praecepit Dominus. Culmen angustum pluviis aptum; ima quadrata fluctibus stabilia.
pass_a_gloss: About ark of-Noah. Length of-three-hundred cubits, width fifty, height thirty; in summit into cubit is-narrowed. Three decks. From clean sevens, from unclean twos. Foods gather. Made Noah all which commanded Lord. Peak narrow to-rains apt; bottoms square to-waves stable.
pass_b_english: Concerning Noah’s ark: [[length three hundred cubits, width fifty, height thirty; at the top it is narrowed to a cubit >> Bible:Genesis 6:15-16]]. Three decks. [[Of the clean, sevens; of the unclean, pairs >> Bible:Genesis 7:2]]. Gather foods. [[Noah did all that the Lord commanded him >> Bible:Genesis 6:22]]. The narrow peak suits the rains; the square base stands steady in the waves.
